title: REQ · Worker loads config, logs structured JSON and enforces a per-World file lock
summary: Config loader, slog JSON logger and exclusive file lock per World
description: Context: no worker module exists. Desired behavior: config.LoadFS reads a worker YAML (world, repo_path, work_root, poll_interval, exec_timeout, max_retries, max_budget_usd, auto_publish, provider) with defaults and validation, logging.New builds a JSON slog logger, and lock.Acquire gives one development execution per World. Expected result: a second acquire fails until release. Why: prevents concurrent executions on one World.
acceptance_criteria: Given a YAML missing optional fields, when loaded, then defaults apply (poll_interval 30s, exec_timeout 30m, max_retries 2, auto_publish false)
Given an empty world, non-positive timeout or negative budget, when loaded, then an error names the field
Given a held lock for a World, when Acquire is called again, then ErrLocked is returned
Given a released lock, when Acquire is called, then it succeeds and the lock file contains the owner
technical_constraints: Lock via os.OpenFile O_CREATE|O_EXCL, no flock dependency
definition_of_done: Config, logger and lock packages compile and behave as specified
non_functional: Lock file removal only by its owner
